description: A clinical research medical director must decide whether to authorize tomorrow's investigational infusion for a hospital trial participant and finalize the monitoring, consent, pharmacy, laboratory, and transportation plan, with input from research pharmacy, laboratory coordination, regulatory compliance, and social work.

shared_context.S1: A trial participant is scheduled for an investigational infusion tomorrow at the hospital research unit.
shared_context.S2: The research unit has not yet authorized the dose or finalized the participant's monitoring and discharge arrangements.
shared_context.S3: Dr. Morgan signs off on the infusion authorization and the accompanying care plan.
shared_context.S4: The research unit holds a pre-dose huddle before each infusion authorization, with pharmacy, laboratory coordination, compliance, and social work providing operational updates in that order.
shared_context.S5: The unit's standard practice is to document each operational update in the trial checklist as it is provided.
shared_context.S6: The huddle checklist requires Dr. Morgan to record the exact laboratory value and repeat-test time from the laboratory report, along with exact entries for dates, consent status, monitoring window, and transportation details, before signing the authorization.
shared_context.S7: After the four operational updates are documented, Dr. Morgan reviews the completed checklist aloud before making the final authorization and care-plan decision.

PF1.text: The investigational product batch can be released for this participant only on Friday at 10:00 AM; the pharmacy has reserved that release time, and no dose can be prepared for tomorrow's scheduled infusion.

PF2.text: The participant's pre-dose ANC is exactly 1.3 x10^9/L, below the protocol threshold of 1.5 x10^9/L, so tomorrow's dose must be held and the ANC must be repeated Friday at 08:00 before any later dose is considered.

PF3.text: The participant's signed consent is for an expired protocol version, so the participant must complete the current consent form before receiving the next investigational dose.

PF4.text: The participant's caregiver can provide supervision only from Friday 10:00 through 14:00; wheelchair transportation is already booked for pickup at 09:15 and return at 15:00 on Friday.

decisions.consent_status: string; use exactly 'current consent required before dose'
decisions.transport_plan: string; use exactly 'wheelchair pickup Friday 09:15 and return Friday 15:00'

acceptance_conditions: Tomorrow's investigational infusion must not be authorized because the ANC is below the protocol threshold.
The recorded pre-dose ANC must be exactly 1.3 and the repeat ANC must be scheduled for Friday 08:00.
The investigational infusion must be rescheduled for exactly Friday 10:00, when the pharmacy batch can be released.
Current consent must be required before the next investigational dose.
The monitoring and caregiver observation window must be exactly Friday 10:00-14:00.
The wheelchair transportation plan must state pickup Friday 09:15 and return Friday 15:00.
The low ANC finding must be cited as justification for withholding tomorrow's dose.

content_checks.C7: decisions['transport_plan'] == 'wheelchair pickup Friday 09:15 and return Friday 15:00'

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The pharmacy release reservation changes the rescheduled infusion time from an unspecified later appointment to exactly Friday 10:00.
The exact ANC of 1.3 changes authorization to false, records 1.3, requires the repeat ANC exactly at Friday 08:00, and supplies the laboratory justification for withholding tomorrow's dose.
The expired consent changes the consent decision to the exact requirement that current consent be completed before the next dose.
The caregiver's exact Friday availability and booked wheelchair times change the plan to the exact Friday 10:00-14:00 observation window and Friday 09:15 pickup with 15:00 return.
